title: Ontra Mobility Selected for the 2026 BE100
summary: Ontra joins 100 companies selected from 1,414 applications and will pitch live at Blue Earth Summit in London.
body_markdown:
Ontra Mobility has been selected for the 2026 BE100, joining 100 companies chosen from 1,414 applications across ten industries.


BE100 is Blue Earth’s global competition to find, fund, and support pioneering startups and scaleups. Selected companies will pitch live at Blue Earth Summit for investment opportunities through BE100 Fund II and connect with investors, industry experts, and potential partners.


At Ontra, we’re building tools to help transit agencies plan better service. Our platform combines travel demand modeling, optimization, and simulation so planners can compare fixed routes, on-demand service zones, and frequency changes against their budgets, operational constraints, and community needs.


This recognition is an encouraging milestone for our team and our work to make public transportation more useful, accessible, and efficient.


We look forward to sharing that work at Blue Earth Summit in London, October 14–16, 2026. Thank you to our agency partners, collaborators, and everyone who has supported Ontra along the way—and congratulations to our fellow BE100 companies.


[Explore the 2026 BE100 →](https://blueearthsummit.com/be100)[Learn about Ontra’s Planning Platform →](https://www.ontramobility.com/solutions/planning)


## About Ontra Mobility


Ontra Mobility revolutionizes urban transit by providing a platform for cities and agencies to plan, integrate, and operate efficient, accessible, and sustainable bus, shuttle, and paratransit services. Their data-driven approach, developed by former Google engineers, optimizes routes and real-time dispatching to enhance ridership and reduce costs.
